notes: Structure size 33x17x43. Floors at y=1, walls y=1..4, facade east wall at x=30, west wall at x=6/13/23.
11 real openings: 2 pizzeria double doors (x=13 and x=23, z=37..38), 8 backstage double doors (7 closed + 1 open), 1 big 3x3 entrance at x=30, z=36..38. No other doors in this structure.

All 9 backstage/pizzeria door openings are exactly 2 wide. The old custom backstage doors were ONE block that rendered a 2-wide 3-tall door; each is now two fnafmw:employee_door leaves (lower y=1, upper y=2) plus the existing 1-block gap at y=3 under the wall above.
Old pizzeria_door has an identical blockstate table to fnafmw:entrance_door, so all four property values (facing/half/hinge/open) are preserved unchanged; only old 'powered' is dropped.

Double-door hinge rule taken from the map's own pizzeria pairs: the leaf on Direction.rotateYCCW(facing) gets hinge=left (east -> north leaf left; west -> south leaf left). Applied to all backstage pairs.

The new big_entrance_door origin is the BOTTOM-left part (part=0), 3 wide/3 tall, model on part=4. The old anchor was the middle block at y=2, so the origin moved to y=1; part=4 then lands back on [30,2,37].

MOST NEW facing BLOCKS ARE 180 DEGREES OPPOSITE THE OLD NAMES (new facing = the wall/back side). Verified from blockstate y-rotations AND model geometry: locker, cardboard boxes, posters, hazard sign, wires, monitor, neon sign, vending machine, arcades, gumball, paper_pal, hanging lamp, desk fan. facing_map north<->south, east<->west applied to those.
Blocks that keep the old facing unchanged: chairs (identical model), diner booth, laptop/terminal, light switch (face=wall), ceiling tile stairs (identical stairs table), entrance/employee doors.

No rotation_y offsets were needed: after the facing_map, every new blockstate variant produces the same y rotation as the old one (checked model-by-model). Rotation-capable blocks without a facing property use position_fixes: classic_speaker rotation=2, exit_sign rotation=4/wall=true, out_of_order_sign rotation=4/wall=false.

Old window_* parts are REMAPPED to minecraft:light_gray_stained_glass instead of fnafmw:window: the new window model is a north/south-facing pane (glass at z=2/z=14), but all 37 windows are in the x=30 EAST facade (X-normal wall) and the new block has no facing/layout rotation for that. Glass keeps the 6x3 openings and matches the glass transoms already used above the pizzeria doors.

party_table modular_type set by old part name (models are geometrically identical): vertical_bottom=1, vertical_middle=5, vertical_top=4, bottom_left=3, middle_left=7, top_left=6, bottom_right=9, middle_right=13, top_right=12. The 3 backstage_table parts use the 3-long vertical run (left=1, middle=5, right=4).

Remaining risks: (1) 2-tall standard doors leave the top block (y=3) of the 3-tall backstage openings empty; big_employee_door would fill it but is 2 blocks deep and would eat into the rooms. (2) hinge left/right is a texture mirror only (vanilla door geometry is identical), so a flipped hinge is cosmetic. (3) stagelight is a BER block; FACE/FACING/colour were set but cannot be visually verified. (4) basic_light_warm is a modular connected light; neighbour flags were left default. (5) brown_facade_bricks_trim face left at default floor; old texture differed. (6) windows lose the old frame detailing.
